name: Glaux
appearance: A large round head with no ear tufts, framed by a near-perfect circular facial disc of charcoal and silver rings around bright yellow eyes. Soft ash-gray plumage is heavily mottled and barred, with a small white "bow-tie" at the throat split by a dark center line. Her tail is long and banded, and her thick, feathered legs end in strong pale talons. She wears a tiny white linen himation edged with a blue meander pattern, draped over one shoulder and fastened with a small bronze fibula, and a simple olive-leaf wreath rests above her facial disc. The beak is short and horn-colored, and she often perches upright on an olive branch, almost knee-high to an adult.
